content.summary: Accept the exact final manuscript within its disclosed local assurance scope. This separate audit adds a fresh exhaustive small-family challenge, verifies the complete 120-submission record and bindings, and reassesses prior repairs. It establishes neither independent certification nor finite obstruction exclusion.

scope_assessments.validity: The actual-support and finite-reduction interfaces match the final claims. Previously inspected selection, codegree, envelope, arithmetic and relabeling bridges remain unchanged. Fresh exhaustive testing corroborates the four-star correction on a bounded domain; universality rests on the supplied derivation and locally compiled source, not that diagnostic.
scope_assessments.claim_limits: Support53 and the Fin53/56 equivalences are complete locally. Finite nonexistence, local formal I(27), both boundary exclusions, sharpness, and any improved extremal value remain unproved. Type-level I(27) and Type-u counterexample reductions are explicitly distinguished.
scope_assessments.contrary_evidence: External enumeration already reports I(27), making the hypothetical class empty if imported; the manuscript acknowledges this. Repeated-point, omitted-overlap and small-L monotonicity attacks invalidate stronger variants, while the actual hypotheses and corrections block them. Relaxation maxima provide no realizable families or optimality certificate.
scope_assessments.methods: The history contains ten chained rounds of twelve submissions, with actual content matching recorded public responses. Mathematical derivation, exact diagnostics, compiler receipts and review votes remain distinct. Same-controller agent contexts do not establish statistical independence.
scope_assessments.reproducibility: All listed evidence hashes and all formal-manifest entries match. The F29 record contains 66 distinct passing roots and axiom-free numerical leaves, following the documented 100+14 project rebuild. This audit did not recompile; Lean/mathlib/package caches and unsigned local provenance remain trusted, without clean full-tree rebuilding or external authentication.
scope_assessments.ethics: Prior work is attributed and the failed solver experiment is not presented as a refutation. F38 limits text comparison to accessible F16/F17 excerpts and records no human review. Global originality, independent human certification, and browser/accessibility conformance are unclaimed. Publication authorization remains local only.
scope_assessments.unresolved_objections: Recomputed history leaves no required revision or open finding. Unsupported citation metadata, heading formatting, the historical MathML overstatement, inline multiplication loss and broken artifact targets have explicit owner closures. F34 preserves the erratum; F35 preserves the repaired products; F37 targets rehash correctly. Visual coverage comes from committed typesetter checks, not this source-level audit. Open mathematical exclusion is accurately declared future work, not an unresolved defect in the reduction.

checks.method: Read FourStar.lean and independently enumerated all subsets of the fifteen four-subsets of a six-point universe, fixing four distinct selected points.
checks.observation: All 32,768 families are intersecting; none violates the stated corrected moment inequality, with equality in 62 cases. For the explicit family {0123,0124}, the squared-degree sum is 14: omitting triple subtraction incorrectly demands 16, while the actual correction demands 14. This directly tests the vulnerable sign and diagonal factors, without constituting a universal proof.

checks.scope: Review integrity, exact-version bindings and repair closure
checks.method: Recomputed canonical record, evidence and verification hashes; compared all 120 historical submissions with committed contents and recorded public JSON; reconstructed the issue ledger; inspected F35 products and rehashed F37 targets.
checks.observation: All ten round hashes, predecessor links, submission bindings and public-response contents match. The final binding matches the last committed round. No required or open issue remains. Six MathML displays and all four protected multiplication expressions are present; both preview/release target pairs match. These are local integrity and closure checks, not proof by reviewer agreement or cross-viewer certification.
